content: Hello! How can I assist you with your account access today?
Hi, I can't remember my password for the staff portal. Can you help me reset it?
Of course! To start, please go to the staff portal login page and click on the 'Forgot Password' link below the password field.
Okay, I clicked on it. It's asking for my company email address.
Please enter your full company email address, then press 'Submit.'
Done. Now it says to check my email for a reset code.
Great! Once you receive the code in your inbox, enter it into the verification box on the portal.
I just got the email and entered the code.
Perfect. Now you'll be prompted to set a new password. Make sure it's at least eight characters and includes a number.
All set, I updated my password and logged in. Thanks for the help!
